🔹 Welcome to Shivraj’s Vet Tales! 🩺🐾

Hello everyone 😊 i am from Maharashtra and i do study in rajasthan on this channel i  share my journey with vlog for each week so hit the subscribe button and join with me .. 😊💖

✨Get ready for a fun-filled ride through my college adventures, hostel masti, and veterinary experiences – all in Marathi! 🎥 

👉 If you love college vibes, animal care, and unfiltered fun, hit that SUBSCRIBE button now! 🚀✨
🔔 Turn on notifications so you never miss an update! 🎉

📍 New videos every week! Let’s make this journey unforgettable! 🚀🐾
